fine_trace.note: loc is declared uninitialized on the stack; its lineno and filename fields will be read later without guaranteed initialization.
When the caller's ci->pc points one-past-the-end of the iseq (last instruction was OP_SEND), pc = ci->pc[-1] makes idx == irep->ilen, which is out of bounds for mrb_debug_get_position.
When idx >= irep->ilen, the function returns FALSE without writing *lp or *fp, leaving loc.lineno and loc.filename uninitialized.
The uninitialized loc.lineno and loc.filename are passed as output parameters; since the function returns FALSE without writing them, they remain uninitialized.
MSAN reports use-of-uninitialized-value here when reading loc.lineno, which was never initialized because mrb_debug_get_position returned FALSE without setting it.
loc.filename is also uninitialized and read here; the uninitialized value propagates to the backtrace output.
packed_backtrace calls each_backtrace to count and pack locations; the uninitialized loc values are copied into the packed backtrace data.
When an exception is raised, mrb_exc_set calls mrb_keep_backtrace, which triggers the uninitialized read in each_backtrace.

fine_trace.code: mrb_exc_raise(mrb, mrb_value exc) { ... mrb_exc_set(mrb, exc); exc_throw(mrb, exc); }
fine_trace.note: mrb_exc_raise is the entry point that leads to mrb_exc_set and the uninitialized backtrace read.
